description: Test suite for UserAccessToken storage operations in Mattermost, including save, get, delete, disable/enable, search, and pagination.

methods.name: TestUserAccessTokenStore
methods.description: Main test function executing sub-tests for user access token storage operations.

methods.name: testUserAccessTokenSaveGetDelete
methods.description: Tests saving, retrieving, and deleting user access tokens and associated sessions.

methods.name: testUserAccessTokenDisableEnable
methods.description: Tests disabling and enabling user access tokens, verifying session deletion and recreation.

methods.name: testUserAccessTokenSearch
methods.description: Tests searching for user access tokens by ID, user ID, and username.

methods.name: testUserAccessTokenPagination
methods.description: Tests pagination of user access tokens by creating multiple tokens and retrieving them in pages.
